tagline: Mars Explorer's buggy, a procedural volcano world and multiplayer laser tag, native in the browser.
headline: Seven builders are working in parallel across Claude 1 and Codex 1, 2 and 3. The foundation runs on WebGPU and the original models and soundtrack are in.

milestones.title: Research and proposal
milestones.detail: Original source studied, reference games dissected, stack chosen.

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.detail: Three.js on WebGPU, Rapier at a fixed 50 Hz, shared slider registry, headless smoke test.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: buggy physics on Martian terrain
milestones.detail: The original buggy handling, ported from source, driving on a procedural landscape. First preview link.

milestones.title: Procedural volcano world from a shared seed
milestones.detail: Dunes, mesas and a climbable volcano generated locally in under 150 ms. Lava, roads and flames follow.

milestones.title: Multiplayer with ramming
milestones.detail: Room server, remote players, physical proxies so vehicles can shove each other, shared sliders.

milestones.title: Alien sky, sun and shadows
milestones.detail: Live time of day and scattering sliders. Nothing baked.

milestones.title: Two buggies: classic Mars Explorer and Syn3h
milestones.detail: Both selectable. The Syn3h model is converted; the classic body is being recovered from the Unity project.

milestones.title: Lava, flames, embers and smoke
milestones.detail: Flowing lava lake and rivers, GPU particles at volcanic vents.

milestones.title: Sound, phone controls and start screen
milestones.detail: Original soundtrack and effects, engine audio, touch controls, name and invite link.

milestones.title: Bots that chase and ram you
milestones.detail: The original bot system, with a slider for how many.

milestones.title: Force field wings and lava buoyancy
milestones.detail: The buggy's glide mode and skipping across lava.

milestones.title: Laser tag
milestones.detail: Lasers, tagging by ram or shot, scores.

milestones.title: Drivable roads and lava rivers placed by the generator
milestones.detail: Second terrain pass, using the lava and particle modules.

milestones.title: Public hosting on Cloudflare
milestones.detail: One Durable Object per room, so friends can join from anywhere.

milestones.title: Hovercraft, jet and tank
milestones.detail: Ported from the original scripts after the buggy skins.

milestones.title: Demo rehearsal
milestones.detail: Full run through on the demo hardware and network, with a fallback plan.

workers.name: Buggy physics (Claude 1)
workers.detail: Porting Buggy.js suspension, motor, friction and steering onto Rapier.

workers.name: Procedural terrain (Claude 1)
workers.detail: Seeded heightfield, Rapier collider, slope and altitude shading.

workers.name: Multiplayer (Claude 1)
workers.detail: Protocol, room server, remote vehicles, ramming, laser tag, host lock.

workers.name: Sky and lighting (Claude 1)
workers.detail: Parametric scattering sky, sun, shadows, fog, presets.

workers.name: Codex 1: buggy skins, then other vehicles
workers.detail: Classic and Syn3h buggy models, force field wings, then hovercraft, jet and tank.

workers.name: Codex 2: lava and particles, then bots
workers.detail: Lava surface and rivers, flames and embers, then the chasing bots.

workers.name: Codex 3: sound, touch, start screen
workers.detail: Original music and effects, engine audio, phone controls, game shell.

decisions.title: Cloudflare access for public multiplayer
decisions.detail: Needed before friends outside your tailnet can join. A wrangler login on this machine or an API token.

strategy.title: Port, do not reinvent
strategy.detail: The original vehicles are one rigid body, raycasts and hand applied forces. That code ports to Rapier nearly line for line, so the handling comes with it.

strategy.title: Four seams, four builders
strategy.detail: Terrain, vehicles, networking and environment each sit behind one small interface, so they are built in parallel worktrees and merged without collisions.

strategy.title: A world is a seed plus sliders
strategy.detail: Every player generates the same terrain locally from one number. Nothing to download, so it loads fast, and every parameter is shared live.

strategy.title: Playable at every step
strategy.detail: Each milestone ends in a preview link. If time runs out, what is left over is polish.

strategy.title: Mars Explorer's own netcode
strategy.detail: Each player simulates their own vehicle. Nearby remote vehicles stay physical, which is what makes ramming work.

accounts.name: Claude 1
accounts.detail: Orchestrator plus four builders. Reset this one first if it runs low; if it runs dry the coordination stops.

accounts.name: Codex 1, 2 and 3
accounts.detail: One builder each, directed by the orchestrator.
